patch_description:
This rewrite uses a deterministic, diversity-filtered elite archive throughout the global search rather than only retaining final restart states. The annealing merit emphasizes both the minimum triangle area and the lower tail of small areas, while active-triangle point selection concentrates moves on current bottlenecks.

The local polishing phase is improved substantially: coordinate maximin constraints are assembled analytically instead of repeatedly copying full point arrays, and the feasible LP polygon is sampled at centroid, vertices, and edge midpoints to retain useful slack rather than always selecting only its centroid. Several diverse elite basins are polished, improving the chance of reaching a stronger active-constraint arrangement while remaining deterministic and avoiding external dependencies.
